prompt: Write a single, self-contained prompt for a text-to-image model that has never heard of Chinese memes, so that it draws a cat version of the "大笑奶龙" (Laughing Nailong / 奶蛙) meme. Output only the prompt.
answer: Create a square reaction sticker showing a kitten laughing so hard its whole body shakes. Give it the shape of a plump golden-yellow baby dinosaur, with a pear-shaped body, a soft cream belly, a head that flows straight into its shoulders, and tiny paws. Make it unmistakably feline with little triangular ears, a button nose, and three short whiskers on each puffy cheek. Show it close up in a slight three-quarter view, leaning back with its chin in the air. Squash its eyes into two tight upward arches and stretch its mouth into an enormous open grin that takes up the lower half of its face. Show a dark mouth, a broad pink tongue, and two tiny kitten fangs. Let its forepaws curl helplessly against its jiggling belly. Render it as a softly lit, slightly squishy 3D cartoon with the goofy immediacy of a frame caught at the peak of a belly laugh. Keep the background plain and pale, with no lettering or watermark.
